title: NuGet Publish Executor
description: Publish a NuGet package to a feed

projectPath.description: Path to the .csproj file (relative to workspace root)

apiKey.description: NuGet API key (can be set via NUGET_API_KEY env variable)

dryRun.description: If true, copy package to local test feed instead of publishing

skipBuild.description: Skip building the project before packing

outputPath.description: Override the default output path for the package
